This directory prepares the pinned Kafka 4.3.1 uniform (`partitioner.adaptive.partitioning.enable=false`) reference for KL05-10. `GenerateUniformSticky.java` calls the official SDK's `BuiltInPartitioner`; it does not reimplement that class. `upstream-source-pin.json` records the exact source commit and hashes used in the design.

The selected Rust contract accounts successfully admitted conservative record bytes plus 61 bytes when a new cohort opens. Keyed and explicit records affect the actual tail without charging the unkeyed counter. An actual full/empty tail can complete a deferred switch with a zero-byte notification; partial drain below the threshold preserves the counter. State pressure uses uniform singleton admissions within fixed topic/cohort/text ceilings. Rust draws use deterministic rejection sampling to remove modulus bias; this differs from Java RNG identity. A producer-wide non-Clone record-slot permit limits reserved admission slots plus accepted records to at most100,000, including empty/null records and buffer_memory=0 traffic. Retry/in-flight movement retains the permit until terminal drop. The cap does not include the existing caller input Vec staged by send_all or claim a bound for every existing producer/network buffer.

The prepared reference events test the uniform state machine, leader eligibility, deferred switching, two-threshold switching, same-partition redraws, and keyed null-info events. They do not establish identical Java accumulator, compression, RNG seed, batch encoding, or whole producer histories. Native librdkafka's time-based sticky contract is separate.

No Java caller, Rust test, live broker, or benchmark has executed during this source preparation. Genuine SDK output, execution commands, identities, and hashes must be recorded after the source checkpoint is pushed. The source-only caller is not an oracle output fixture.
